```{r}
#| include: false

# Load required libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(yaml)
  library(scholar)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(rvest)
  library(xml2)
  library(rentrez)
})

# Read CV data from YAML file
cv_data <- read_yaml("cv_data.yml")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Schema validation — fail LOUDLY on typo'd / renamed keys.
#
# Why: every section below renders with `if (!is.null(x)) ... else "None listed"`.
# A misspelled YAML key therefore looks identical to an empty section and the
# render succeeds with silently missing content. This check turns that into a
# hard error, and prints a per-section count so empty sections are visible in
# the render log.
#
# Maintenance: if you add a NEW section to cv_data.yml, add it here too.
#   - character vector value  = required sub-keys of a mapping section
#   - NA                      = section is a plain list of entries
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cv_schema <- list(
  personal                         = c("name", "positions", "links"),
  extra_pmids                      = NA,
  exclude_pmids                    = NA,
  education                        = NA,
  employment                       = NA,
  thesis_examiner                  = NA,
  thesis_defense_chairperson       = NA,
  thesis_proposal_examiner         = NA,
  phd_comprehensive_examiner       = NA,
  data_safety_monitoring_committees = NA,
  grant_review_committees          = NA,
  academic_honours                 = NA,
  trainee_supervision              = c("in_progress", "completed"),
  thesis_advisory_committee_member = c("in_progress", "completed"),
  teaching                         = c("graduate_courses", "guest_lectures"),
  conference_session_organizing    = NA,
  invited_talks_seminars           = NA,
  external_research_funding        = NA,
  internal_research_funding        = NA,
  editorial_review                 = c("journals"),
  preprints                        = NA
)

validate_cv_data <- function(data, schema) {
  problems <- character(0)
  counts   <- character(0)

  # 1. Every section the CV renders must exist in the YAML.
  missing_sections <- setdiff(names(schema), names(data))
  if (length(missing_sections) > 0) {
    problems <- c(problems, sprintf(
      "Missing top-level section(s) in cv_data.yml: %s",
      paste(missing_sections, collapse = ", ")))
  }

  # 2. Sections present in the YAML but unknown here are usually a typo
  #    (e.g. 'trainee_supervison') or a new section that needs adding above.
  unknown_sections <- setdiff(names(data), names(schema))
  if (length(unknown_sections) > 0) {
    problems <- c(problems, sprintf(
      paste0("Unknown top-level section(s) in cv_data.yml: %s\n",
             "  -> typo, or a new section that must be added to cv_schema in cv.qmd"),
      paste(unknown_sections, collapse = ", ")))
  }

  for (section in intersect(names(schema), names(data))) {
    expected_subkeys <- schema[[section]]
    value <- data[[section]]

    if (length(expected_subkeys) == 1 && is.na(expected_subkeys[1])) {
      # Plain list section.
      counts <- c(counts, sprintf("  %-34s %d entries", section, length(value)))
      next
    }

    # Mapping section: sub-keys must match exactly.
    if (!is.list(value) || is.null(names(value))) {
      problems <- c(problems, sprintf(
        "Section '%s' should be a mapping with sub-keys: %s",
        section, paste(expected_subkeys, collapse = ", ")))
      next
    }

    missing_subkeys <- setdiff(expected_subkeys, names(value))
    if (length(missing_subkeys) > 0) {
      problems <- c(problems, sprintf(
        paste0("Section '%s' is missing sub-key(s): %s\n",
               "  -> found instead: %s"),
        section,
        paste(missing_subkeys, collapse = ", "),
        paste(names(value), collapse = ", ")))
    }

    unknown_subkeys <- setdiff(names(value), expected_subkeys)
    if (length(unknown_subkeys) > 0) {
      problems <- c(problems, sprintf(
        paste0("Section '%s' has unrecognised sub-key(s): %s\n",
               "  -> expected: %s"),
        section,
        paste(unknown_subkeys, collapse = ", "),
        paste(expected_subkeys, collapse = ", ")))
    }

    for (sub in intersect(expected_subkeys, names(value))) {
      # Only count list-valued sub-keys; scalars (e.g. personal$name) aren't
      # collections and a count would be meaningless noise.
      if (!is.list(value[[sub]])) next
      counts <- c(counts, sprintf("  %-34s %d entries",
                                  paste0(section, "$", sub),
                                  length(value[[sub]])))
    }
  }

  # Per-section counts: a section that reads 0 entries is either genuinely
  # empty or a sign something went wrong upstream — either way, visible.
  message("\n=== cv_data.yml section counts ===")
  message(paste(counts, collapse = "\n"))
  message("==================================\n")

  if (length(problems) > 0) {
    stop(paste0(
      "\n\n*** cv_data.yml FAILED VALIDATION — CV NOT RENDERED ***\n\n",
      paste0("  - ", problems, collapse = "\n\n"),
      "\n\nFix cv_data.yml (or update cv_schema in cv.qmd), then re-run ./refresh.sh\n"),
      call. = FALSE)
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}

validate_cv_data(cv_data, cv_schema)

# Helper function to format names with bold for Steven Hawken
bold_author <- function(text) {
  gsub("(Hawken S|Hawken, S|Steven Hawken|S Hawken|S\\.? Hawken)",
       "**\\1**",
       text,
       ignore.case = FALSE)
}

# Helper function to escape pipes in table cells
escape_pipes <- function(text) {
  if (is.null(text) || is.na(text)) return("")
  gsub("\\|", "/", text)
}

# Summary count line for a list of trainees, broken down by degree type.
# Returns a preformatted italic markdown line, or NULL if there are no entries.
# Any degree label not in `degrees` (e.g. a typo, or a new category) is counted
# and displayed separately rather than silently dropped from the totals.
degree_summary <- function(entries, degrees = c("PhD", "MSc", "PDF")) {
  if (is.null(entries) || length(entries) == 0) return(NULL)

  labels <- vapply(entries, function(e) {
    d <- e$degree
    if (is.null(d) || length(d) == 0 || is.na(d)) "Degree unspecified" else trimws(as.character(d))
  }, character(1))

  parts <- sprintf("%d %s", vapply(degrees, function(d) sum(labels == d), integer(1)), degrees)

  other <- setdiff(unique(labels), degrees)
  if (length(other) > 0) {
    parts <- c(parts, sprintf("%d %s",
                              vapply(other, function(o) sum(labels == o), integer(1)),
                              other))
  }

  sprintf("*%s — %d total*\n\n", paste(parts, collapse = " · "), length(entries))
}

# Simple total count line (no degree breakdown).
total_summary <- function(...) {
  groups <- list(...)
  n <- sum(vapply(groups, length, integer(1)))
  if (n == 0) return(NULL)
  sprintf("*%d total*\n\n", n)
}
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Header with name and download button
personal <- cv_data$personal
name <- personal$name
positions <- personal$positions
links <- personal$links

cat("# ", name, "\n\n")

# Display positions
if (!is.null(positions) && length(positions) > 0) {
  for (pos in positions) {
    cat(pos, "\n\n")
  }
}

# Display links
if (!is.null(links)) {
  link_parts <- c()
  if (!is.null(links$ohri_profile)) link_parts <- c(link_parts, sprintf("[OHRI Profile](%s)", links$ohri_profile))
  if (!is.null(links$google_scholar)) link_parts <- c(link_parts, sprintf("[Google Scholar](%s)", links$google_scholar))
  if (!is.null(links$pubmed)) link_parts <- c(link_parts, sprintf("[PubMed](%s)", links$pubmed))
  if (!is.null(links$orcid) && links$orcid != "https://orcid.org/") link_parts <- c(link_parts, sprintf("[ORCID](%s)", links$orcid))
  if (!is.null(links$github)) link_parts <- c(link_parts, sprintf("[GitHub](%s)", links$github))
  if (length(link_parts) > 0) cat(paste(link_parts, collapse = " | "), "\n\n")
}
```

## Research Funding

### External Research Funding

```{r}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

external <- cv_data$external_research_funding

if (!is.null(external) && length(external) > 0) {
  # Create table data
  table_data <- data.frame(
    Years = character(),
    Source = character(),
    Title = character(),
    Role = character(),
    Amount = character(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  for (grant in external) {
    # Format amount
    amount <- ""
    if (!is.null(grant$amount_cad)) {
      amount <- paste0("$", format(grant$amount_cad, big.mark = ","), " CAD")
    } else if (!is.null(grant$amount_usd)) {
      amount <- paste0("$", format(grant$amount_usd, big.mark = ","), " USD")
    } else if (!is.null(grant$amount_total_cad)) {
      amount <- paste0("$", format(grant$amount_total_cad, big.mark = ","), " CAD")
    }

    table_data <- rbind(table_data, data.frame(
      Years = if (!is.null(grant$year)) grant$year else "",
      Source = escape_pipes(grant$funder),
      Title = escape_pipes(grant$title),
      Role = escape_pipes(if (!is.null(grant$role)) grant$role else ""),
      Amount = amount,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  knitr::kable(table_data, format = "html")
}
```

## Publications

```{r}
#| output: false
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: true
#| cache: false
#| freeze: false
# Global logger. Quarto hides messages from this chunk, so every step of the
# publication fetch is written to _pubmed_fetch.log in the CV folder instead.
# (log_msg used to be defined only inside fetch_myncbi(), so fetch_pmids()
# could not see it and crashed whenever extra_pmids was non-empty.)
log_path <- "_pubmed_fetch.log"
log_msg <- function(...) {
  cat(format(Sys.time()), " ", ..., "\n", sep = "", file = log_path, append = TRUE)
}
# Sentinel: prove this chunk ran (even if Quarto suppresses messages)
cat("---- pub fetch chunk started ", format(Sys.time()), " ----\n",
    file = "_pubmed_fetch.log", append = TRUE)

# ---- Google Scholar profile (for stats only: h-index, i10, total cites) ----
profile <- NULL
tryCatch({
  profile <- scholar::get_profile("aTyysxgAAAAJ")
}, error = function(e) {
  profile <- NULL
})

# ---- Peer-reviewed publications: MyNCBI scrape -> rentrez -> RDS cache ----
pubmed_cache_file <- "_pubmed_cache.rds"
myncbi_url <- cv_data$personal$links$pubmed

# Normalised columns for downstream display:
#   authors, title, journal, date, pmid
empty_pubs <- data.frame(
  authors = character(), title = character(), journal = character(),
  date = character(), pmid = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# --- Method 1: scrape MyNCBI public bibliography ---
# Each citation is a <div class="citation"> containing:
#   .authors, <a href="/pubmed/PMID/">title</a>, .source (journal),
#   .pubdate, .volume, .issue, .doi, .pmid, plus
#   <input class="citation-check" pmid="..."> with the PMID as an attribute.
# MyNCBI paginates at 50 citations/page; ?pageSize= is ignored — we walk
# ?page=1,2,3... until a page returns 0 citations or repeats PMIDs.
fetch_myncbi <- function(url, max_pages = 20) {
  safe_text <- function(node) {
    if (inherits(node, "xml_missing")) return("")
    txt <- rvest::html_text2(node)
    if (is.null(txt) || is.na(txt)) "" else txt
  }

  parse_page <- function(page) {
    items <- page %>% rvest::html_elements("div.citation")
    if (length(items) == 0) return(NULL)

    rows <- lapply(items, function(item) {
      docsum <- rvest::html_element(item, "div.ncbi-docsum")
      if (inherits(docsum, "xml_missing")) docsum <- item

      authors <- safe_text(rvest::html_element(docsum, ".authors"))
      authors <- sub("\\.\\s*$", "", trimws(authors))

      title_node <- rvest::html_element(docsum, "a[href*='/pubmed/']")
      title <- trimws(safe_text(title_node))

      journal <- trimws(safe_text(rvest::html_element(docsum, ".source")))
      pubdate <- sub(";\\s*$", "", trimws(safe_text(
        rvest::html_element(docsum, ".pubdate"))))
      volume  <- trimws(safe_text(rvest::html_element(docsum, ".volume")))
      issue   <- trimws(safe_text(rvest::html_element(docsum, ".issue")))

      date <- pubdate
      if (nzchar(volume)) date <- paste0(date, ";", volume)
      if (nzchar(issue))  date <- paste0(date, issue)
      date <- trimws(date)

      pmid <- ""
      check <- rvest::html_element(item, "input.citation-check")
      if (!inherits(check, "xml_missing")) {
        attr_val <- rvest::html_attr(check, "pmid")
        if (!is.null(attr_val) && !is.na(attr_val)) pmid <- attr_val
      }
      if (!nzchar(pmid)) {
        ptxt <- safe_text(rvest::html_element(docsum, ".pmid"))
        m <- regmatches(ptxt, regexpr("\\d+", ptxt))
        if (length(m)) pmid <- m
      }
      if (!nzchar(pmid) && !inherits(title_node, "xml_missing")) {
        href <- rvest::html_attr(title_node, "href")
        if (!is.null(href) && !is.na(href)) {
          m <- regmatches(href, regexpr("\\d+", href))
          if (length(m)) pmid <- m
        }
      }

      data.frame(authors = authors, title = title, journal = journal,
                 date = date, pmid = pmid, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    })
    do.call(rbind, rows)
  }

  tryCatch({
    # MyNCBI's pagination uses bare ?page=N and ignores it when appended to
    # an existing query string (e.g. ?sort=date&direction=descending&page=2
    # silently returns page 1). Strip the existing query before paging.
    base_url <- sub("\\?.*$", "", url)
    acc <- list()
    seen_pmids <- character(0)

    log_path <- "_pubmed_fetch.log"
    log_msg <- function(...) {
      cat(format(Sys.time()), " ", ..., "\n",
          sep = "", file = log_path, append = TRUE)
    }
    cat("---- new fetch ", format(Sys.time()), " ----\n",
        file = log_path, append = TRUE)
    log_msg("base_url = ", base_url)

    for (p in seq_len(max_pages)) {
      page_url <- paste0(base_url, "?page=", p)
      log_msg("fetching: ", page_url)
      page <- tryCatch(rvest::read_html(page_url),
                       error = function(e) {
                         log_msg("  read_html error: ", conditionMessage(e))
                         NULL
                       })
      if (is.null(page)) break

      df   <- parse_page(page)
      n_raw <- if (is.null(df)) 0L else nrow(df)
      log_msg("  parsed ", n_raw, " citations from page ", p)
      if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) break

      new_rows <- df[!df$pmid %in% seen_pmids, , drop = FALSE]
      log_msg("  ", nrow(new_rows), " new (not duplicates)")
      if (nrow(new_rows) == 0) break

      acc[[length(acc) + 1]] <- new_rows
      seen_pmids <- c(seen_pmids, new_rows$pmid)

      if (nrow(df) < 50) {
        log_msg("  partial page (<50), stopping")
        break
      }
    }
    log_msg("MyNCBI total collected: ", length(seen_pmids))

    if (length(acc) == 0) return(NULL)
    df <- do.call(rbind, acc)
    df <- df[nchar(df$title) > 0 & nchar(df$pmid) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
    df
  }, error = function(e) {
    log_msg("MyNCBI scrape FAILED: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  })
}

# --- Method 2: rentrez PubMed search ---
# Now the PRIMARY source: MyNCBI uses JS-based pagination so a non-headless
# scraper can't get past page 1.
# Query strategy: match on ORCID (cleanest) OR on author name + Ottawa-area
# affiliations (catches pre-ORCID-adoption papers, ~pre-2015).
fetch_rentrez <- function(orcid = "0000-0002-3341-9022",
                          author_term = "Hawken S[Author]",
                          aff_terms = c("Ottawa", "OHRI",
                                        "Institute for Clinical Evaluative Sciences",
                                        "ICES",
                                        "CHEO",
                                        "Children's Hospital of Eastern Ontario",
                                        "McMaster University",
                                        "Hamilton Health Sciences",
                                        "Population Health Research Institute"),
                          retmax = 1000) {
  tryCatch({
    aff <- paste0("(",
                  paste(sprintf("%s[Affiliation]", aff_terms), collapse = " OR "),
                  ")")
    aff_clause <- paste0("(", author_term, " AND ", aff, ")")

    if (!is.null(orcid) && nzchar(orcid)) {
      query <- paste0("(", orcid, "[AUID] OR ", aff_clause, ")")
    } else {
      query <- aff_clause
    }

    sres <- rentrez::entrez_search(db = "pubmed", term = query, retmax = retmax)
    log_msg("rentrez search found ", length(sres$ids), " PMIDs (of ", sres$count, " total)")
    if (length(sres$ids) == 0) return(NULL)

    # Fetch in batches of 100 to be polite.
    # NB: parsed = TRUE would return an XMLInternalDocument from the old {XML}
    # package, which xml2's functions don't recognise. Fetch as text and
    # reparse with xml2 so the rest of the code can use xml_find_*.
    id_chunks <- split(sres$ids, ceiling(seq_along(sres$ids) / 100))
    xml_docs <- lapply(id_chunks, function(ids) {
      raw <- rentrez::entrez_fetch(db = "pubmed", id = ids,
                                   rettype = "xml", parsed = FALSE)
      xml2::read_xml(raw)
    })

    parse_article <- function(art) {
      gx <- function(xp) {
        n <- xml2::xml_find_first(art, xp)
        if (inherits(n, "xml_missing")) "" else xml2::xml_text(n)
      }
      pmid    <- gx(".//PMID")
      title   <- gx(".//ArticleTitle")
      journal <- gx(".//Journal/Title")
      year    <- gx(".//JournalIssue/PubDate/Year")
      if (!nzchar(year)) {
        md <- gx(".//JournalIssue/PubDate/MedlineDate")
        year <- substr(md, 1, 4)
      }
      volume <- gx(".//JournalIssue/Volume")
      issue  <- gx(".//JournalIssue/Issue")
      pages  <- gx(".//Pagination/MedlinePgn")

      authors_nodes <- xml2::xml_find_all(art, ".//AuthorList/Author")
      authors <- vapply(authors_nodes, function(a) {
        last <- xml2::xml_text(xml2::xml_find_first(a, "LastName"))
        init <- xml2::xml_text(xml2::xml_find_first(a, "Initials"))
        if (is.na(last)) {
          coll <- xml2::xml_text(xml2::xml_find_first(a, "CollectiveName"))
          if (is.na(coll)) "" else coll
        } else {
          paste0(last, if (!is.na(init) && nzchar(init)) paste0(" ", init))
        }
      }, character(1))
      authors <- paste(authors[nzchar(authors)], collapse = ", ")

      date <- year
      vip <- ""
      if (nzchar(volume)) vip <- volume
      if (nzchar(issue))  vip <- paste0(vip, "(", issue, ")")
      if (nzchar(pages))  vip <- paste0(vip, ":", pages)
      if (nzchar(vip))    date <- paste0(date, ";", vip)

      data.frame(
        authors = authors, title = title, journal = journal,
        date = date, pmid = pmid,
        year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(substr(year, 1, 4))),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }

    all_rows <- list()
    for (doc in xml_docs) {
      arts <- xml2::xml_find_all(doc, ".//PubmedArticle")
      for (a in arts) all_rows[[length(all_rows) + 1]] <- parse_article(a)
    }
    df <- do.call(rbind, all_rows)
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

    # Most recent first
    df <- df[order(-df$year, df$title), ]
    df$year <- NULL
    log_msg("rentrez parsed ", nrow(df), " articles")
    df
  }, error = function(e) {
    log_msg("rentrez fetch FAILED: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  })
}

# --- Method 3: fetch metadata for an explicit PMID list ---
# Used to pull in papers the auto-search misses (older Lancet papers, etc.).
fetch_pmids <- function(pmids) {
  pmids <- as.character(pmids)
  pmids <- pmids[nzchar(pmids)]
  if (length(pmids) == 0) return(NULL)
  tryCatch({
    log_msg("fetching ", length(pmids), " explicit PMIDs from extra_pmids")
    id_chunks <- split(pmids, ceiling(seq_along(pmids) / 100))
    xml_docs <- lapply(id_chunks, function(ids) {
      raw <- rentrez::entrez_fetch(db = "pubmed", id = ids,
                                   rettype = "xml", parsed = FALSE)
      xml2::read_xml(raw)
    })
    parse_article <- function(art) {
      gx <- function(xp) {
        n <- xml2::xml_find_first(art, xp)
        if (inherits(n, "xml_missing")) "" else xml2::xml_text(n)
      }
      pmid    <- gx(".//PMID")
      title   <- gx(".//ArticleTitle")
      journal <- gx(".//Journal/Title")
      year    <- gx(".//JournalIssue/PubDate/Year")
      if (!nzchar(year)) year <- substr(gx(".//JournalIssue/PubDate/MedlineDate"), 1, 4)
      volume  <- gx(".//JournalIssue/Volume")
      issue   <- gx(".//JournalIssue/Issue")
      pages   <- gx(".//Pagination/MedlinePgn")
      authors_nodes <- xml2::xml_find_all(art, ".//AuthorList/Author")
      authors <- vapply(authors_nodes, function(a) {
        last <- xml2::xml_text(xml2::xml_find_first(a, "LastName"))
        init <- xml2::xml_text(xml2::xml_find_first(a, "Initials"))
        if (is.na(last)) {
          coll <- xml2::xml_text(xml2::xml_find_first(a, "CollectiveName"))
          if (is.na(coll)) "" else coll
        } else paste0(last, if (!is.na(init) && nzchar(init)) paste0(" ", init))
      }, character(1))
      authors <- paste(authors[nzchar(authors)], collapse = ", ")
      date <- year; vip <- ""
      if (nzchar(volume)) vip <- volume
      if (nzchar(issue))  vip <- paste0(vip, "(", issue, ")")
      if (nzchar(pages))  vip <- paste0(vip, ":", pages)
      if (nzchar(vip))    date <- paste0(date, ";", vip)
      data.frame(authors = authors, title = title, journal = journal,
                 date = date, pmid = pmid,
                 year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(substr(year, 1, 4))),
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }
    rows <- list()
    for (doc in xml_docs) {
      arts <- xml2::xml_find_all(doc, ".//PubmedArticle")
      for (a in arts) rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- parse_article(a)
    }
    if (length(rows) == 0) return(NULL)
    df <- do.call(rbind, rows); df$year <- NULL; df
  }, error = function(e) {
    log_msg("fetch_pmids error: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL
  })
}

# --- Method 0 (PRIMARY): your exported My NCBI bibliography ---
# The CV lists exactly what your My NCBI bibliography holds. To refresh:
#   My NCBI > My Bibliography > select ALL citations (not just the page on
#   screen) > Manage citations > Export file > save it in this folder as
#   my_bibliography.nbib (overwrite the old one), then run ./refresh.sh.
# The export is MEDLINE text, parsed here with no web requests at all.
# A plain list of PMIDs (one per line) also works: then the details are
# fetched from PubMed by PMID with fetch_pmids().
# (Scraping the public bibliography page directly is not an option: NCBI's
# robots.txt blocks automated access to My NCBI pages, and its paging is
# JavaScript-only, which is why fetch_myncbi() only ever got page 1.)
bib_export_file <- "my_bibliography.nbib"

parse_medline <- function(lines) {
  recs <- list(); cur <- list(); last_tag <- NULL
  flush <- function() {
    if (length(cur) > 0) recs[[length(recs) + 1]] <<- cur
    cur <<- list(); last_tag <<- NULL
  }
  for (ln in lines) {
    if (!nzchar(trimws(ln))) { flush(); next }
    if (grepl("^[A-Z0-9]{2,4} *- ", ln)) {
      tag <- trimws(sub("^([A-Z0-9]{2,4}) *- .*$", "\\1", ln))
      val <- trimws(sub("^[A-Z0-9]{2,4} *- ", "", ln))
      if (tag == "PMID" && !is.null(cur$PMID)) flush()  # record with no blank line
      cur[[tag]] <- c(cur[[tag]], val)
      last_tag <- tag
    } else if (!is.null(last_tag)) {
      # Continuation line (indented): append to the previous field
      n <- length(cur[[last_tag]])
      cur[[last_tag]][n] <- paste(cur[[last_tag]][n], trimws(ln))
    }
  }
  flush()

  rows <- lapply(recs, function(r) {
    f1 <- function(tag) if (!is.null(r[[tag]])) r[[tag]][1] else ""
    title <- f1("TI"); if (!nzchar(title)) title <- f1("BTI")
    authors <- paste(c(r[["AU"]], r[["CN"]]), collapse = ", ")
    journal <- f1("JT"); if (!nzchar(journal)) journal <- f1("TA")
    year <- substr(f1("DP"), 1, 4)
    vip <- f1("VI")
    if (nzchar(f1("IP"))) vip <- paste0(vip, "(", f1("IP"), ")")
    if (nzchar(f1("PG"))) vip <- paste0(vip, ":", f1("PG"))
    date <- if (nzchar(vip)) paste0(year, ";", vip) else year
    data.frame(authors = authors, title = title, journal = journal,
               date = date, pmid = f1("PMID"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })
  if (length(rows) == 0) return(NULL)
  df <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  df <- df[nzchar(df$title), , drop = FALSE]
  df[!(nzchar(df$pmid) & duplicated(df$pmid)), , drop = FALSE]
}

read_bibliography <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    log_msg("no bibliography export found at ", path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  tryCatch({
    lines <- sub("\r$", "", readLines(path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"))
    log_msg("reading ", path, " (saved ", format(file.mtime(path)), ")")
    if (any(grepl("^PMID- ", lines))) {
      df <- parse_medline(lines)
      log_msg("parsed ", if (is.null(df)) 0 else nrow(df), " records from MEDLINE export")
    } else {
      pmids <- unique(unlist(regmatches(lines, gregexpr("\\b[0-9]{6,9}\\b", lines))))
      log_msg("found ", length(pmids), " PMIDs in a plain list; fetching details from PubMed")
      df <- fetch_pmids(pmids)
    }
    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) NULL else df
  }, error = function(e) {
    log_msg("reading bibliography export FAILED: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  })
}

# --- Execute with fallback chain ---
# 1. Your exported bibliography (primary). 2. PubMed search via rentrez, only
# if the export is missing or unreadable. 3. Last saved copy (further down).
pubmed_pubs <- read_bibliography(bib_export_file)
pubmed_source <- if (!is.null(pubmed_pubs)) "My NCBI bibliography" else NA_character_

if (is.null(pubmed_pubs)) {
  log_msg("falling back to PubMed search (rentrez)")
  pubmed_pubs <- fetch_rentrez()
  if (!is.null(pubmed_pubs)) pubmed_source <- "PubMed (rentrez)"
}

# --- Merge in extra_pmids and apply exclude_pmids ---
extra <- fetch_pmids(cv_data$extra_pmids)
if (!is.null(extra) && nrow(extra) > 0) {
  if (is.null(pubmed_pubs)) {
    pubmed_pubs <- extra
  } else {
    extra <- extra[!extra$pmid %in% pubmed_pubs$pmid, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(extra) > 0) pubmed_pubs <- rbind(pubmed_pubs, extra)
  }
  log_msg("merged ", nrow(extra), " new papers from extra_pmids")
}

if (!is.null(pubmed_pubs) && length(cv_data$exclude_pmids) > 0) {
  before <- nrow(pubmed_pubs)
  pubmed_pubs <- pubmed_pubs[
    !pubmed_pubs$pmid %in% as.character(cv_data$exclude_pmids), , drop = FALSE]
  log_msg("excluded ", before - nrow(pubmed_pubs), " from exclude_pmids")
}

# Re-sort by year desc after merging
if (!is.null(pubmed_pubs) && nrow(pubmed_pubs) > 0) {
  yr <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(regmatches(
    pubmed_pubs$date, regexpr("\\d{4}", pubmed_pubs$date))))
  if (length(yr) == nrow(pubmed_pubs)) {
    pubmed_pubs <- pubmed_pubs[order(-yr, pubmed_pubs$title), ]
  }
}

if (!is.null(pubmed_pubs) && nrow(pubmed_pubs) > 0) {
  saveRDS(pubmed_pubs, pubmed_cache_file)
} else if (file.exists(pubmed_cache_file)) {
  pubmed_pubs <- readRDS(pubmed_cache_file)
  pubmed_source <- "cached"
  log_msg("ALL LIVE FETCHES FAILED: showing old cache saved ",
          format(file.mtime(pubmed_cache_file)))
}

if (is.null(pubmed_pubs)) pubmed_pubs <- empty_pubs
log_msg("FINAL: ", nrow(pubmed_pubs), " publications, source = ", pubmed_source)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# Display profile statistics from Google Scholar if available
if (!is.null(profile)) {
  cat("**Profile Statistics (Google Scholar):**\n\n")
  cat("- **H-Index**: ", profile$h_index, "\n")
  cat("- **i10-Index**: ", profile$i10_index, "\n")
  cat("- **Total Citations**: ", profile$total_cites, "\n\n")
}

cat("### Peer-Reviewed Publications\n\n")

# Display publications from PubMed, numbered 1..N (no year grouping)
if (!is.null(pubmed_pubs) && nrow(pubmed_pubs) > 0) {
  cat("*Source: ", pubmed_source, " — ", nrow(pubmed_pubs),
      " publication(s).*\n\n", sep = "")

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(pubmed_pubs))) {
    pub <- pubmed_pubs[i, ]

    authors <- bold_author(pub$authors)
    title   <- pub$title
    journal <- pub$journal
    date    <- pub$date
    pmid    <- pub$pmid

    # Build Vancouver-ish citation: Authors. Title. *Journal*. Date. [PMID: #####]
    citation <- paste0(i, ". ", authors, ". ")

    if (!is.null(title) && !is.na(title) && nzchar(title)) {
      # Strip trailing period from title if present, then add our own.
      title_clean <- sub("\\.\\s*$", "", title)
      citation <- paste0(citation, "**", title_clean, "**. ")
    }

    if (!is.null(journal) && !is.na(journal) && nzchar(journal)) {
      citation <- paste0(citation, "*", journal, "*. ")
    }

    if (!is.null(date) && !is.na(date) && nzchar(date)) {
      date_clean <- sub("\\.\\s*$", "", date)
      citation <- paste0(citation, date_clean, ". ")
    }

    if (!is.null(pmid) && !is.na(pmid) && nzchar(pmid)) {
      citation <- paste0(
        citation,
        sprintf("[PMID: [%s](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/%s/)]", pmid, pmid)
      )
    }

    cat(citation, "\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("*Publications not currently available. Please check again later.*\n\n")
}
```
